note: Negative precedents — requests this authority has declined, with the reason and the routes to try instead. Maintained via adjudication (2026-10-07) and reviewer verdicts. Kernel-generic: any authority may carry this file.

precedents.title: Progress ring, streak counter & badge tiles
precedents.request: progress ring · streak counter · badge tiles
precedents.reason: The ring is off-grammar (D-02 rectilinear); streak and badges compose from catalogued primitives; the square meter is the progress element (D-15).
try: Use the square meter for progress (D-15).
Compose streaks and counts from display numerals plus the ruled register; keep rectangles.

precedents.title: Saving indicator, celebration motion & toasts
precedents.request: saving indicator · check-off celebration · toast notification
precedents.reason: Motion is gated by doctrine (D-15/D-22); the golden set keeps motion deliberately UNDEFINED; the saving state is a meter composition, and the notice declines toast vocabulary (D-13).
try: Use the meter for advancing work.
Keep things still; a brief static red ceremony accent is the sanctioned adaptation.
For transient feedback, use the ruled notice (D-13) — no toasts.

precedents.title: View tabs & paging control
precedents.reason: The nav idiom is already decided (D-08; carried in component/masthead active state); paging composes from outline actions + a plain readout.
try: Use the masthead active state for view switching.
Compose paging from outline buttons plus a readout.

precedents.title: Pictograms & category tags
precedents.reason: Pictograms are prohibited (D-22) — the adaptation to ordinals was correct; markers and tags are ruled-register compositions (D-10 label idiom).
try: Use ordinals (01–05) or word labels in the ruled register.
Never add pictograms; keep bilingual word pairs.

precedents.title: Photographic imagery & uploads
precedents.request: avatar photo · empty-state illustration · photo upload
precedents.reason: Imagery is unlicensed (D-22; D-16: imagery absence is a system property); the adaptations (initials plate, ruled statement, written note) are correct.
try: Use initials plates, ruled statements, and written notes.
No photos or illustrations on any surface.

precedents.title: Reversed colourway / dark mode (proposal rejected at review)
precedents.request: token-set/colour extension — reversed colourway (white on black) for dark presentation
precedents.reason: Rejected at gate review (no reviewer note recorded); the proposed dark token mapping was declined and the light canon stands.
try: Dark mode rides the light-only fallback as a marked improvisation.
Do not extend token-set/colour with a reversed mapping without evidence.

precedents.title: Dialog vessel & empty state (proposal rejected at review)
precedents.request: component/dialog + component/empty-state — modal vessel for ritual details and the empty state
precedents.reason: Rejected at gate review (no reviewer note recorded); the proposal would have canonised overlay vessels and empty states the register does not evidence.
try: Keep flows in-page: ruled statements and in-flow blocks.
An empty state composes from a ruled statement plus one outline action; no overlay vessels without evidence.
